bridge.when: Ayyub: uncertain (about 1500 BCE by some reckonings); Shu'ayb: before Musa
bridge.where: Ayyub: the hills of the Levant; Shu'ayb: Madyan, in north-western Arabia
text: Two prophets whose stories stand apart from the great family stories, both descended from Ibrahim according to the commentaries.
Ayyub, known as Job, is remembered for his patience through terrible loss. Shu'ayb is sent to Madyan, a trading town of cheats. Musa will later flee to Madyan and live there for ten years.
